notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}{W}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{W}.
Cast Village Bell-Ringer by paying {2}{W}.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Village Bell-Ringer to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}{G}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana.
